We do the rest. Charter KOKO for an afternoon sunset cruise, full-day adventure, or plan a dream vacation on a 4-day or 6-day

blurb: KOKO is managed by Equity Estates Marine Management, LLC and chartered through Equity Estates Travel Services, LLC (“EETS”). EETS curates and promotes once in a lifetime travel experiences and travel “Extras” to investors in Equity Estates Funds and other luxury travelers. These experiences include custom tours through Tuscany, river cruises down the Danube, and private charters in the Galapagos, BVI, and USVI.
